name: MG Motor
verdict: Owned by SAIC Motor Corporation Limited, whose controlling shareholder (63.71%) is the Chinese state-owned SAIC (Group) under Shanghai SASAC.
note: Rating note: Proposed 'serious': the Chinese state controls SAIC Motor through SAIC (Group)'s 63.71% stake, so the state sits in the owner chain at well over 5%, and the UN OHCHR Xinjiang assessment plus Human Rights Watch document serious abuses by that state. ON HOLD: a proposed 'serious' rating (state ownership with a documented record) awaits a maintainer's review.
